metadata.title: Leonardo Caimmi — Full Stack Developer
metadata.description: Full Stack Developer specialised in backend engineering with Java and Spring Boot. REST APIs, PostgreSQL data modelling and applications built with React, Angular and Expo.

focus.title: Schema first
focus.body: I model the data before writing an endpoint. A good schema prevents half the bugs that would otherwise reach production.

focus.title: Security in the engine
focus.body: Authorisation belongs in the database, not the client. Row Level Security, policies and triggers before trusting the frontend.

focus.title: Explaining to understand
focus.body: Teaching forces me to justify every architectural decision. Anything I cannot explain, I do not yet understand.
